privacyAiThirdPartyBody: The AI Coach uses the Google Gemini API. Messages you send to the Coach are transmitted via HTTPS to Google servers to generate a response. Google's data processing terms apply (cloud.google.com/terms/data-processing-terms). Please do not share sensitive personal information (passwords, financial details, medical records) with the AI Coach.
privacyChildrenBody: Mentra is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided data, please contact us for immediate deletion.
privacyContactBody:
Tever Technology

privacyDataCollectBody:
LOCAL DATA (stored only on your device): Session scores, reaction times, streaks, journal entries, cognitive radar scores, and mood checks. This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly export it.

AI COACH DATA: When you use the AI Coach feature, your messages are sent to Google's Gemini API to generate responses. Google's privacy policy applies to this data (policies.google.com/privacy). We do not store your chat history on our servers; it is stored locally on your device and deleted when you clear the conversation.

PURCHASE DATA: If you subscribe to Mentra Pro, your purchase is processed via Apple App Store and RevenueCat. We only receive your subscription status, not payment card details.
privacyDataNotCollectBody: We do NOT collect: your name or email address (unless provided for support), device identifiers for advertising purposes (IDFA), precise location data, contacts, camera or microphone data, or any biometric data. Mentra does not operate advertising networks or sell user data to brokers.
privacyOverviewBody: Mentra is a cognitive training application developed by Tever Technology. We are committed to protecting your privacy with a 'Local-First' architecture. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights across various jurisdictions including the EU, US, Turkey, Japan, and South Korea.
privacyRightsBody:
You can delete all your data at any time in Settings → Data & Privacy → Reset. Uninstalling the app permanently deletes all local data.

EU/UK Users (GDPR): You have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your data. Mentra acts as a Data Controller for minimum purchase status and a Data Processor via Local Storage.

US Users (CCPA/CPRA): We do not 'sell' or 'share' your personal information. You have the right to know what data is collected and request its deletion.

Turkish Users (KVKK): Your rights under Law No. 6698 are fully respected. Data remains on your device.

Japanese Users (APPI): We comply with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information. Your cognitive data is considered personal information and is processed locally on your device.

South Korean Users (PIPA): We comply with the Personal Information Protection Act. User data is not transmitted to third parties except for AI processing as described in Section 4.

Persian (FA) / Iranian Users: We respect all relevant data protection regulations and ensure no sensitive personal info is stored on our servers. All cognitive data remains on your device.

MENA Users (PDPL): We comply with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and relevant regional regulations.

Indian Users (DPDP Act 2023): We comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act. No personal data is transmitted to our servers.
privacyStorageSecurityBody: All local data is stored in the app's private sandboxed storage (AsyncStorage), protected by your device's local security systems (Passcode, Face ID, or Biometrics). We use HTTPS for all external communications and leverage industry-standard protocols to prevent unauthorized access.
